entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Editor TextChanged event not firing on ios 26.1 release build (but does in debug mode) #32651
  • MediaPicker.PickPhotosAsync does not preserve image orientation #32650
  • MediaPicker.PickPhotosAsync returns null in some cases #32649
  • Visual Studio 2026 with .NET 9: no iOS emulator or device showing up #32645
  • Make sure we can revert to default inflator per file #32644
    .NET 10.0 SR2

Closed

  • Building app gets stuck when MauiXamlInflator is set to SourceGen #32623
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [net10, XSG] Named controls under OnPlatform are not recognized when compiling for different platform #32521
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • x:Static on generated types #32627
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • .Net Maui - .Net 10 - ICanvas - Fonts not useable in ICanvas #32643
  • [iOS 26] Navigation hangs after rapidly open and closing new page using Navigation.PushAsync #32425
    .NET 10.0 SR2

PullRequests

Created

  • Shell Flyout appears in Release builds even when FlyoutBehavior="Disabled" - fix #32648
    platform/macos, platform/ios, community ✨
  • Return stub IAlertManagerSubscription for standard AlertManager #32646
    community ✨

Merged

  • Fix infinite loop in ProvideValueForReferenceExtension with x:Reference #32638
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Enable OnPlatform element simplification for InitializeComponent code generation #32534
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] better AppThemeBinding #32441
    xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] Add clr-namespace fallback for x:Static with unresolved types #32630
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [XSG] add XmlLineInfoProvider #32530
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS] RTL column mirroring in UICollectionView - fix #32372
    platform/ios, p/0, community ✨, collectionview-cv2, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] [Android] Refactor selection limit handling in MediaPicker #32628
    .NET 10.0 SR1.1
  • [Android] NET10 - Exception on quit - fix #32647
    platform/android, area-controls-shell, community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR2

Updated

  • [iOS 26] Navigation hangs after rapidly open and closing new page using Navigation.PushAsync - fix #32456
    area-navigation, platform/ios, p/0, community ✨, version/iOS-26, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix Shell content page title clipping on Android API 28-29 with window insets compatibility #32537
    partner/syncfusion/review, .NET 10.0 SR1.1
  • Inflight/current #29755
    platform/macos, platform/windows, platform/android, platform/ios, area-infrastructure
  • Fix CollectionView FlowDirection="RightToLeft" stop working after update from maui version 9.0.110 to 9.0.120 #32318
    platform/ios, p/0, area-controls-collectionview, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 32509 - [11/17/2025] Candidate #32590
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Add VisualTestUtils source to replace deprecated NuGet package #32607
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Add support for private types in SetBinding using UnsafeAccessorType #32618
  • Improve TypedBinding performance #32382
    .NET 11 Planning
  • [XSG] Add heuristic to support bindable properties generated by other source generators #32597
